title: Happy Toddler Riding Tricycle Outdoors, 1958 Suburbia B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A cheerful toddler bundled in a dark coat, mittens, and warm bonnet or hood smiles broadly while riding a three-wheeled tricycle equipped with handlebar streamers. Captured on a paved suburban driveway or sidewalk, the background showcases mid-century tract houses characteristic of 1950s post-war suburban development in America. The print features classic deckle edges and an imprinted processing date of 'APR • 58' along the right white margin.
